quantification_note: Explicitly undeclared 2026-09-03: the bundle records only the unit repair (mg/kg -> ppb); no method sentence on disk (CML/CEL are conventionally LC-MS/MS, not asserted). The envelope keeps the core's absolute-concentration convention for this row and says so.

metadata.notes: Representative AGE proxy benchmark derived from the Foods 2023 commercial PBMA survey. Encodes a midpoint operating point while the full product-range bands remain attached through safety reference payloads.

unit_correction_note.what_changed: conc_ppb held the source's mg/kg values (CML 32.0, CEL 55.0) in a field declared as ppb. They now hold true ppb: 32.0 mg/kg x 1000 = 32000 ppb and 55.0 mg/kg x 1000 = 55000 ppb. Source values are the Fu et al. (2023) commercial-PBMA midpoints (CML 16.46-47.61 mg/kg, CEL 25.21-86.23 mg/kg).
unit_correction_note.expected_miss: This benchmark is now EXPECTED TO FAIL. src.safety.predict_cml/predict_cel return ppb (see the UNITS contract in src/safety.py) and their empirical constants were tuned against the mis-unit-ed values, so at these conditions they predict 26.6 ppb (CML) and 51.7 ppb (CEL) against 32000 and 55000 ppb: ratios 1204x and 1064x, i.e. 3.08 and 3.03 log10 units low. Mean abs log10 error ~3.05 against a 0.25 contract.
unit_correction_note.policy: Tolerances are deliberately UNCHANGED. The pre-correction pass (ratios 1.005-1.204) was an artifact of the unit collision, not agreement; loosening the contract would hide a real 1000x calibration gap. Fix the predictors against real ug/kg data, do not retune the tolerance.
